description:
Register discovered Proxmox CTs/VMs in the inventory and place them on the map, inside the Proxmox box.
Every subcommand is a DRY-RUN by default; --apply saves (with a copy in runs/copias-seguranca/network/).

  register  -- add hosts to network/hosts.yaml from a spec YAML
  place     -- lay out the hosts of a Proxmox (runs_on) in a grid inside its box on map "all"
  append    -- box with a custom layout: add below the least full column
  zone      -- Proxmox with no zone on the map: create box + note + bridge and link the host

`register` spec (list `hosts`; `proxmox` and `ct` become `runs_on` + the note "CT N do <PROXMOX> (host P)"):

    proxmox: 18
    hosts:
      - {{hostname: PROXY-TESTE, ip: 10.8.200.211, ct: 102, os: UBUNTU, os_version: '20.04',
         apps: [TRAEFIK, DOCKER], notes: "4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM."}}
      - {{hostname: CHR-X, ip: 192.168.99.1, ct: 300, kind: VM, os: ROUTEROS, model: CHR, icon: router}}  # VM: ct = VMID
help_register: add hosts to network/hosts.yaml from a spec YAML
help_place: lay out a Proxmox's hosts inside its box on the map
help_hosts: IDs and order (default: all with runs_on = proxmox)
help_append: add hosts to a box with a custom layout, without rearranging
help_xy: manual positions, one 'x,y' per host (full box)
help_zone: create the box/note/bridge of a Proxmox that has no zone on the map yet
